final: SELECT a.frequency AS statement_release_frequency, t.k_symbol AS debit_purpose, SUM(t.amount) AS total_debited FROM account AS a JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.account_id = 3 AND t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.k_symbol = 'SLUZBY' GROUP BY a.frequency, t.k_symbol HAVING SUM(t.amount) = 195
